run_train: run the train function to train a LLM model with FSDP, gradient accumulation, and optional profiling
run_evaluation: run the evaluation function to evaluate a model on a dataloader and return perplexity and loss
freeze_transformer_layers: freeze the first N transformer layers of a model by setting requires_grad to False
freeze_llm_only: freeze all self-attention layers in the language model while keeping cross-attention layers trainable
setup_distributed: initialize the distributed process group using NCCL or CCL backend for multi-GPU training
